TauCeti/Algebra/Octonion/Basic.lean defines the split octonions as Zorn vector matrices with their algebra structure, conjugation, trace, norm, and proves multiplicativity of the norm, alternativity, all three Moufang identities, and dimension counts (8 for octonions, 7 for imaginary). TauCeti/Algebra/Octonion/Derivation.lean develops the derivation Lie algebra of the split octonions, proving derivations are imaginary-valued and skew for the norm form, constructing three families of derivations (𝔰𝔩₃, upper, lower) with their brackets, and establishing a linear equivalence 𝔰𝔩₃ × R³ × R³ ≃ Der 𝕆 yielding finrank = 14. Both files contain executable declarations and proofs, are not pure import aggregators, and their content is not duplicated elsewhere.
